From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Sent: Thursday, December 5, 2019 2:45 PM
To: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Pistons beat 
 
Cool, I'll touch base later.

Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Sent: Thursday, December 5, 2019 2:32 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: RE: Pistons beat 
 
Sure. Stop by. I’m here all day.

From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Thursday, December 5, 2019 2:31 PM
To: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Pistons beat

No problem. I’m available to meet at your earliest convenience. I think this is a very important meeting to have, given the circumstances and timing. I’m leaving for the winter meetings tomorrow. I will be meeting with a source in Corktown at 5 p.m.; if you are in the office today, could we meet after you get out?

From: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Sent: Thursday, December 5, 2019 11:38 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: RE: Pistons beat
Anthony: Thanks for your note. Apologies for the delayed response; yesterday was hectic.
I’m happy to talk more about it, but my decision has been made.

I’m moving you to the Pistons beat in February, effective the day after Vince’s last day. You can pursue any sports enterprise or feature storytelling of your choosing during the offseason – or even in-season if we agree on it in advance – but your first job will be handling the Pistons.
My expectation is for you to excel in this new role. And I think you will.
I appreciate your renewed willingness to work together.
Let me know when/if you want to meet. I go on vacation Dec. 12.

From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Wednesday, December 4, 2019 9:45 AM
To: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Pistons beat
I’m sorry I did not get back to you sooner. I wanted to take some time and make sure these words are right, given the circumstances.
First, I am not taking the buyout. With the Friday deadline, I felt it was only necessary to notify the Guild in the case I decided to take it.

As far as my assignment, if I did not explicitly say so in last Monday’s meeting, I would like to continue covering the Tigers. In my five years on the beat, I have established myself as one of the best baseball writers in the country. Locally, I own the beat in every aspect. I feel a strong sense of responsibility in covering this team.

I regret any previous issues that have led us to this point and I am confident we can put these issues aside and find a common ground in having success. This was my full intention in seeking the aforementioned meeting.

I would appreciate the opportunity to express my thoughts and put everything on the table, with the hope that we can come to an understanding of how to work together. I’m committed to improving our communication and working relationship.

From this perspective, you, I, the Free Press sports department and most importantly - its readers - are best-served by us leaving no stone unturned in trying to make this work. I truly believe that we can.

From: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Sent: Tuesday, December 3, 2019 1:44 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Pistons beat
Just checking in. Can I move forward with the reassignment to Pistons in February, or did you decide to take the buyout?
Great Lakes regional sports director, USA TODAY Network
